identity_gate: confirm jewelry material is sugilite-bearing material rather than relying on the trade name alone
record matrix/chalcedony mixture or associated minerals where visible/relevant
use lab identity for meaningful-value purchases when supplier evidence is insufficient
updates.pricing_unit: single bead/piece + weight/size; round-bead strand may be a commercial sub-spec

reference_anchors.evidence: Jewelry-quality Wessels Mine material may be predominantly manganoan sugilite or chalcedony mixed/colored by sugilite; composition and associated minerals matter to identity.
Uniform/intense purple is typically valued highly; attractive veining and patterned material can also be desirable.
Laboratory reports can identify colored stones and detectable treatments when higher-value batch verification is needed.

updates.purchase_rule: Do not create a universal low/mid/high 8mm band from seller labels alone. First lock identity/treatment + visual class; then compare same-size/same-class beads or individual pieces.
